messages:
alex_infra: opened support case with Azure to increase gpu quota (ND96/A100 sku) + additional NICs for new westus3 subscription. Case 2200456789. We need the quota before we cut over staging -> prod next week, and we also need VNET peering permission between 'redwood-staging-westus3' and prod. cc @raj_ops @deepa_ml

raj_ops: thanks alex. can you paste the subscription id and tenant id here? also how many NICs do we need per vm and expected concurrent vms?

alex_infra: sub: 2f4a1e3b-7c9d-4f21-9a2b-5c6d7e8f9012 tenant: 8b3f2d4a-1111-2222-3333-4444f66e7a88. planning 12 VMs concurrently, each needs 8 NICs for network isolation (ingress/proxy/sidecar). total NICs request = 96.

oncall-bot: Deploy window reminder: staging -> prod cutover scheduled 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Ensure infra quotas are approved 72h prior.

deepa_ml: 12 concurrent ND96s seems right for load tests. if Azure gives soft quota only, we should request burst capacity + guaranteed. ask for "regional capacity reservation" in the same support note.

azure_support_bot: Support case 2200456789 created. Initial response from Azure support: "We've verified the subscription and see soft quotas in westus3. To proceed with dedicated capacity and NIC quota increase, please provide workload justification and contact info. Escalation to regional capacity team is possible; allow 24-48h for review." Reference: SR# AZ-2200456789-REG.

sam_eng: can we include cost calc to justify request? rough numbers: ND96 A100 preemptible-ish hourly ~ $6.5/hr (spot), $20/hr (on-demand) per VM. 12 vms running 8h/day 5d/wk => monthly delta ~= $12k on-demand. include that in justification.

alex_infra: noted. adding cost paragraph + perf targets (p50 < 150ms for 1k rps). pasted justification into Azure case. also requested NICs = 96, and asked for VNET peering permission to subscribe-prod-id (prod-sub: 3c5b2a11-aaaa-4444-bbbb-555566667777).

raj_ops: can you also add the support contact for infra@redwood.ai and our account rep (marta@azure-partners)? that usually speeds escalation.

alex_infra: done. message from Azure support thread (copied): "We have queued a capacity review. To expedite, please confirm whether dedicated ND96s can be deployed into an existing subscription with ExpressRoute or if a new subscription is required. Also confirm the exact SKU names and region."

deepa_ml: SKU names: Standard_ND96asr_v4 for A100 (accelerator), region westus3. also confirm if NVv4 family or other variants acceptable? we prefer ND96asr_v4 for performance parity with current infra.

alex_infra: replied to Azure: confirm existing subscription with ExpressRoute is fine, preferred SKU Standard_ND96asr_v4, and we need regional capacity reservation if possible. asked for tentative ETA.

azure_support_bot: Update 1769345899: "Case escalated to capacity team. Preliminary ETA 36-48h for review. If approved, NIC increases will be applied and capacity reservation options presented. For urgent needs, Tier 2 on-call will follow up."

sam_eng: thanks. can infra add a temp fallback plan if Azure can't meet timeline? maybe shift 25% load to GCP (p4d) or fall back to dedicated instances in eu-west4 for short window. need ops runbook.

raj_ops: +1 on runbook. alex, can you draft brief runbook steps (failover, traffic cut, DNS TTL changes)? keep it < 10 steps.

alex_infra: drafting now. quick snippet I pushed to #runbooks:\n```\n- reduce traffic to westus3 by 25% via weighted LB (10:90 -> 0:100)\n- spin up 3 p4d-equivalent instances in eu-west4, attach to cross-region svc mesh\n- warm cache using replay traffic generator for 30m\n- switch DNS TTL to 30s and cutover route weights over 10m\n- monitor p50/p95 latency and token cost\n```\n
deepa_ml: looks good. add a rollback note: if latency > 2x baseline after cut, revert weights and notify SRE.

azure_support_bot: Update 1769346123: "Tier 2 has acknowledged SR# AZ-2200456789-REG and requested network diagrams + ExpressRoute circuit ID. Please upload docs to the case portal. We will provide a final decision within 36h of receiving diagrams."

alex_infra: uploading diagrams now and pinging account rep. marking this thread as monitored. :eyes: 

raj_ops: thanks. I'll be on standby for followups.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if case is still pending 24h prior to deploy window, trigger emergency runbook and exec notify.
